the-frozen-crypt.look: Photoreal cinematic anamorphic photography, shallow depth of field, subtle organic grain, soft halation. Palette locked to obsidian black, ice-blue, bone white and one thin ember-gold accent. Cold desaturated grade, crushed blacks. One hard key light from high camera-left, deep chiaroscuro, volumetric haze, slow drifting dust. A single clean full-frame cinematic image, with no lettering of any kind.

shots.0: Extreme wide locked-off shot with an imperceptible push-in. An almost empty field of deep space; over the shot a single cold point of light slowly resolves into a colossal hollowed asteroid with a cathedral-sized mouth carved into its flank. No other object, no ship, no light source. The scale is so large the asteroid reads as a landform, not a rock. Villeneuve's Dune, Roger Deakins lighting. Motion so slow it should feel almost static.
shots.1: Hard cut from cosmic scale to microscopic: extreme macro, crawling right-to-left across black obsidian split by veins of white ice. Hairline filaments of frozen gold suspended inside the ice like lightning caught mid-strike. Raking cold side light, razor-thin focus plane, foreground crystal bokeh. The first statement of the piece: we are already inside.
shots.2: Slow forward push through a towering ice-sealed crypt doorway carved from raw asteroid rock. Frost hangs motionless in vacuum-cold air. The doorway's cut edges catch a thin ice-blue rim light while the interior falls to near-black, and the frame passes into that darkness., deep focus into nothing, one faint lens flare as we cross the threshold.
shots.3: Steadicam glide down an empty corridor of polished obsidian, its walls etched with extinct star maps. Cold starlight falls through a single slot above; slow vertical columns of dust hang in the beam. Symmetrical one-point perspective, restrained and desaturated. A surveyor's lamp beam sweeps slowly across the etched wall and the etched lines briefly catch the light.
shots.4: HERO TITLE SHOT. Camera glides laterally past a frost-covered sarcophagus of black stone inlaid with a single hairline of gold. Ice dust lifts off the stone as if the air is exhaling. The ember-gold inlay is the only warm tone in the entire piece and it catches the light exactly as the shot settles. Slow parallax, hero lighting, immaculate and reverent.
shots.5: Tight on an ancient bronze-gold seal half-buried in black ice. Frost blooms across its surface in real time, crystals advancing slowly outward. Warm gold against a cold blue field. Extremely shallow focus, claustrophobic and breath-held.
shots.6: Slow aerial drift forward and slightly down above a field of ice-locked tomb markers inside a cavernous asteroid hollow. The markers recede into cold blue haze far past the point where they should. No horizon line, no sky. Monumental and cold - the first hint this place is far larger than a single tomb.
shots.7: Abstract and still: a single cold star reflected in a perfectly undisturbed sheet of black ice, one dying gold ember at the extreme frame edge. The reflection does not waver. Deep focus, immaculate negative space. The only truly still shot in the piece - a held breath.
shots.8: Slow 180-degree orbit around a monolithic frozen pillar carved with extinct dynasty glyphs. Ice-blue key from behind turns the glyph edges into rim light. As the camera passes, the carved glyphs are visibly the same star maps seen in the corridor earlier - the place rhymes with itself., heavy parallax, frost cracking silently across the stone.
shots.9: CLIMAX SHOT. Extreme macro on the buried seal as frost crystals begin growing directly toward camera, faster than nature allows. Then the seal cracks: a single dark fracture opens along the gold line and does not close. macro, then racking focus from crystal to crack, light bleeding from inside the fracture.
shots.10: Tracking shot deeper into the crypt. Multiple ice shafts of cold starlight cut diagonal beams through dust - and for the first time the beams are MOVING, sweeping slowly across the chamber as though the light source is no longer fixed., high contrast, flare as the frame crosses each beam.
shots.11: Wide of a collapsed star-tomb chamber beneath a dome of frozen mist. Broken architecture recedes into haze in every direction. The mist is no longer still - it rolls and lifts, and small debris begins to rise off the floor. Sombre, monumental, desaturated.
shots.12: Low angle looking up inside the crypt at ice-locked celestial machinery - enormous geared rings and orrery arms - humming with faint amber-gold light through the frost. It is TURNING, slowly and impossibly, completing a rotation. Camera rises along the structure, dwarfed by it. Grand, oppressive, older than anything alive.
shots.13: Extreme close-up of a fossilized stellar crown embedded in black ice. Its gold edges are dull and cold - ancient metal that has forgotten light - and when the surveyor's lamp falls across it, it does NOT respond. The one object in the tomb that is genuinely dead., razor-thin focus, exquisite cold texture.
shots.14: Slow dolly past rows of silent frozen memory banks while cold vapour rolls low across the floor and debris drifts upward. Each bank holds a faint dying internal glow, flickering irregularly. Repetition receding into darkness, one-point perspective. Handheld instability beginning to creep into the frame.
shots.15: Obsidian floor, near-black, reflecting one shaft of blue starlight and a single thin gold crack running toward camera. Everything else is immaculate darkness. Locked off, minimal, almost abstract - the last stillness before the floor gives.
shots.16: Camera rises vertically through a narrow ice shaft toward a single distant cold star framed by the crypt mouth far above. The rules of the piece break here: frost and debris now fall UPWARD past the lens, and the beam of light bends slightly. Slow, vertiginous, awe-struck and wrong.
shots.17: Ice and ash swirling into a spiral tomb sigil in the air, then violently dissolving back into black void - twice, in hard pulses. Particles rotate with real physical weight, lit by one cold source that strobes. Restrained and graphic; no text and no marks that read as letters.
shots.18: THE TURN. Wide interior reveal of the Star Tomb: a hollow asteroid cathedral of ice and obsidian. One tiny explorer silhouette - featureless, entirely backlit, no face - stands alone on an immense floor, dwarfed by architecture that dwarfs them further the longer you look. The figure does not move. Slow crane rise. The only human figure in the entire piece, and it appears far too late.
shots.19: Very slow pullback from the sealed frozen crypt doors as cold starlight flares across the asteroid exterior. The doors are closing - and the silhouette is on the inside. The doors shrink into the rock, the asteroid becomes the subject, then space swallows it entirely., grand and final.
shots.20: A black ice horizon under infinite stars with one dying gold ember. Almost no motion at all - a held breath after everything. The calmest frame in the piece. Extremely wide, deep focus, vast negative space.
shots.21: Minimal obsidian horizon with a hairline gold glow beneath an immense black sky and a distant ice asteroid silhouette. Near-silhouette, elegant, extreme negative space. The world reduced to a line and a glow.
shots.22: One last pulse: a black void in which a single cold star flares once, hard and brief - light from inside the sealed tomb - revealing for a half-second the faint outline of the crypt mouth seen from within, then fading back to darkness. The loudest beat in the track lands on this flare.
shots.23: Very slow drift back out through the threshold as the crypt mouth narrows to a sliver of starlight, and then to nothing. Hold on absolute black. Silent, closed, final.

dust-of-a-dead-dynasty.look: Photoreal cinematic anamorphic photography, shallow depth of field, subtle organic grain, soft halation. Palette locked to obsidian black, ice-blue, bone white and one thin ember-gold accent. Cold desaturated grade, crushed blacks. One hard key light from high camera-left, deep chiaroscuro, volumetric haze, slow drifting dust. A single clean full-frame cinematic image, with no lettering of any kind.

shots.0: Absolute black void. Then, on a single hard hit, a colossal dynasty sigil - a ring of interlocking crowns - ignites in the dark, cold and enormous, gold lines on black. It fills the frame and holds. The title moment of the piece. Slow, monumental, reverent.
shots.1: Extreme wide of a dynasty mausoleum-city carved into a dead world: thousands of identical black towers, each a tomb, receding in perfect rows to the horizon. Cold starlight, no wind, absolute order. Locked-off with an imperceptible push-in.
shots.2: Slow forward push down a processional avenue lined with colossal seated statues of dead kings, each holding a star. The statues are identical, black stone, gold inlay. The camera passes the first king and the avenue recedes into haze. Symmetrical one-point perspective.
shots.3: The machinery of the dynasty: enormous geared orreries and star-charts turning slowly, gold and obsidian, humming with faint amber light. Slow camera drift past the turning gears. Grand, ordered, alive.
shots.4: A dynasty banner - a gold sigil on black - unfurls in a slow wind, snapping taut. The only motion in a still world. Gold thread catching cold light. The empire declares itself.
shots.5: A dynasty fleet: thousands of identical black warships holding perfect formation in the void, engines burning cold blue. One ship breaks formation and drifts away. The rest do not move. Monumental scale, deep space.
shots.6: Forge-worlds: asteroid foundries pouring molten gold, sparks arcing in zero-g, rivers of liquid metal. The camera drifts through the sparks. Industrial, vast, relentless.
shots.7: A colossal statue of the founding king being carved by machines - the dynasty building its own myth. Chisels strike, stone falls, gold inlay set. Slow crane rise up the statue's full height.
shots.8: Legions of identical black-armoured figures marching in perfect lockstep across a plain of ash. Thousands of them, endless, in perfect rows. Low angle, dust rising, boots in unison.
shots.9: The war machine: ranks of siege-titans and orbital cannons, all gold and obsidian, all aimed outward into the void. Slow lateral dolly past the ranks. Massive, ordered, unassailable.
shots.10: A dynasty throne-room: a single gold throne on a dais of black stone, empty, lit by one shaft of cold light. The camera circles it slowly. The seat of power, and no one sits in it.
shots.11: Star-maps of the conquered galaxy, gold lines on black, slowly rotating in a dark hall. The lines glow faintly. Slow camera drift across the map. The empire's reach, drawn in gold.
shots.12: The armies march: a sea of black figures and war-machines crossing a bridge of light over a void. Endless, in perfect order. High angle, dust and light, relentless motion.
shots.13: Industry: endless foundries and shipyards, molten gold rivers, sparks, hammers falling in unison. The camera moves through the heat and light. The machine at full tilt.
shots.14: A dynasty monument - a ring of crowns - seen from directly below, colossal, the camera tilting up its full height into the dark. Gold edges catching light. Its scale is the point.
shots.15: The fleet at full burn: thousands of ships accelerating together, light streaking past the camera. Motion blur, cold blue engines, gold hulls. The empire at its peak, moving as one.
shots.16: A single held frame: the empty gold throne on its black dais, the gold sigil behind it, perfectly still. One shaft of cold light. Nothing moves. The second the empire dies, before it knows it. Absolute stillness.
shots.17: The first crack: a hairline fracture runs up the colossal statue of the founding king, gold flaking off the stone. The camera holds on the crack as it spreads. Slow, inevitable, wrong.
shots.18: The throne-room's single shaft of light goes out, plunging the room to black. Then the gold sigil cracks in two with a hard impact. Two blows, two cuts. Black between them.
shots.19: The fleet turns on itself: ships firing at each other, gold and fire in the void, hulls breaking, light flaring. The camera is caught in the barrage. Violent, chaotic, the order unmade.
shots.20: The colossal statues of the dead kings topple, one by one, shattering into dust and gold. Each impact throws a cloud of ash. The camera tracks the fall. Symmetry in destruction.
shots.21: The mausoleum-city burns: thousands of black towers, gold fire climbing them, smoke and embers. The camera rises above the burning city. The order of Act I, unmade.
shots.22: The armies dissolve: the identical black figures crumbling to ash in the wind, one by one, in perfect order, until the plain is empty dust. The wind carries them away.
shots.23: The dynasty sigil - the ring of crowns - shatters and falls as dust, the gold pieces tumbling into black. Then a field of drifting gold and black ash under one cold shaft of light, one last ember fading. Hold on the dust. Then blacken black.
